chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
I have neither spoken a lie nor have I been told a lie. I have neither deviated nor have I been made to deviate (others).

key_terms.ضُلَّ بِي: I was made to deviate others / I caused deviation
key_terms.كُذِّبْتُ: I was told a lie / I was lied to (passive)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his truthfulness and guidance?
ai.summary: In this declaration from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) affirms his personal and communal infallibility (Ismah) in conveying the divine message, a concept central to Shia theology. By asserting that he neither erred nor was misled, he establishes his role as the perfect exemplar of the Prophet’s legacy, ensuring the authenticity of Islamic teachings. This statement underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing their status as the uncorrupted source of religious authority.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 185. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
I have neither spoken a lie nor have I been told a lie. I have neither deviated nor have I been made to deviate (others).
